profile.name: Casey Mac
profile.title: Senior Software Engineer
profile.bio: Builds resilient .NET platforms, developer tooling, and polished portfolio experiences for technical audiences.

projects.name: Legacy API Rebuild
projects.narrative:
Rewrote a collection of ageing SOAP-based internal APIs as lightweight RESTful JSON services using ASP.NET Core.
Collaborated with senior engineers to define contracts, wrote integration tests, and documented endpoints in OpenAPI.
Third-party partners reported a 40% reduction in integration effort after the rollout.
projects.briefSummary: Rewrote ageing SOAP endpoints as RESTful JSON APIs, improving third-party integration speed by 40%.

projects.name: CI/CD Pipeline Overhaul
projects.narrative:
Designed and implemented a Jenkins-based CI/CD pipeline that replaced a fragile manual release process relying on shared network drives and tribal knowledge.
Containerised build agents using Docker to eliminate "works on my machine" failures, and authored runbooks covering rollback procedures.
Release cadence improved from once a fortnight to multiple times per week, and mean time to recovery dropped by 70%.
projects.briefSummary: Replaced a fragile manual release process with an automated CI/CD pipeline, cutting release time from days to under an hour.

projects.name: Client Self-Service Portal
projects.narrative:
Designed and delivered a customer-facing self-service portal in React and TypeScript backed by a .NET Core API and PostgreSQL database.
The portal allowed clients to manage subscriptions, download invoices, and raise support requests without phoning the helpdesk.
Within three months of launch, inbound support ticket volume dropped by 35% and customer satisfaction scores improved measurably.
projects.briefSummary: Built a React and .NET Core customer portal that reduced support ticket volume by 35%.

projects.name: Reporting Engine
projects.narrative:
Designed a centralised reporting engine that replaced a patchwork of ad-hoc SQL scripts and manual Excel exports scattered across the business.
Reports were defined as composable query templates, rendered server-side, and cached in Azure Blob Storage for repeat consumers.
End-user report generation time fell from several minutes to under five seconds for the most commonly requested dashboards.
projects.briefSummary: Replaced slow ad-hoc SQL queries with a centralised reporting service, reducing report generation time from minutes to seconds.

projects.name: Platform Migration
projects.narrative:
Led a full migration of the legacy monolith to a containerised .NET microservices platform running on Azure Kubernetes Service.
Reduced deployment cycle time by 60% and eliminated environment parity issues across staging and production.
projects.briefSummary: Migrated legacy monolith to containerised .NET microservices on Azure Kubernetes Service, cutting deployment cycle time by 60%.

projects.name: AI Feature Pipeline
projects.narrative:
Architected and delivered an event-driven pipeline that uses Azure OpenAI to classify, tag, and enrich incoming content records at scale.
The pipeline processes thousands of items per hour across Kubernetes-hosted workers, with Redis used for deduplication and rate-limit buffering.
Replaced manual analyst review workflows, freeing a team of three analysts to focus on edge-case handling and quality audits rather than routine throughput.
Latency SLA for enrichment dropped from 24 hours to under 90 seconds end-to-end.
projects.briefSummary: Built an LLM-powered content enrichment pipeline that automated classification tasks previously handled by a team of three analysts.

projects.name: Internal Developer Platform
projects.narrative:
Led the technical design and rollout of an internal developer platform built on Backstage, Terraform, and GitHub Actions.
The platform provides golden-path templates for new services, automated environment provisioning, and a unified software catalogue.
Onboarding a new microservice — including repository setup, CI/CD pipelines, secrets management, and cloud infrastructure — now takes less than one working day, down from two weeks of manual steps.
Adoption reached 80% of all active engineering squads within six months of general availability.
projects.briefSummary: Led the design of an internal platform that cut new-service bootstrapping time from two weeks to under a day.
